Home.testimonial1Quote: Before Pack Brand, our cups and boxes looked generic. Now every order that leaves our kitchen is a brand moment. Our customers actually comment on the packaging — and that's free marketing.
Home.testimonial2Quote: We have three locations and needed packaging that looked consistent and professional across all of them. Pack Brand delivered on time and the quality exceeded what we were paying before with our old supplier.
Home.testimonial3Quote: The stickers and labels make our brand look premium without the premium price. We ordered 5,000 units and they arrived in 9 days. Couldn't ask for more.
Home.testimonial4Quote: We were paying 30% commission to third-party apps. With Pack Brand Direct, our customers order directly from us. In the first 60 days, we recovered thousands of dollars we were losing every month.
Home.testimonial5Quote: The setup was fast and the platform is incredibly simple to use. Our staff learned it in one afternoon. Now we have our own ordering system, our own data, and we control the experience completely.
Home.testimonial6Quote: What sold me was the bilingual support. We have customers who prefer to order in English and others in Spanish. Pack Brand Direct handles both seamlessly — and so does their team when we need help.

About.heroTitle: Dressing Brands for Success Since Day One
About.heroDescription: We started Pack Brand Solutions with one mission: give small businesses access to the same premium custom packaging that big brands use. Bilingual, fast, and affordable.
About.storyText1: Pack Brand Solutions was founded by entrepreneurs who understood the struggle: small restaurants, food trucks, and emerging brands deserved packaging that looked as good as their food tasted — but the big packaging companies only wanted to work with big brands.
About.storyText2: We changed that. Today we serve hundreds of businesses across the United States, offering premium custom cups, bags, boxes, food containers, and labels with low minimum orders, and bilingual support.
About.missionTitle: Your Logo. Your Brand. Your Identity.
About.missionText: Every cup, bag, and box we produce is a marketing opportunity for your business. We make sure your brand is front and center — from the first order to the thousandth.
About.ctaDescription: Join hundreds of brands who trust Pack Brand Solutions for their custom packaging. Let’s build your brand.
